BehaviorTree._description: Hold the arm at URDF zero (every joint mid-travel; gripper NEAR-CLOSED) and run this to read each joint's Feetech `offset` error in servo ticks. The six numbers and the offset correction recipe are printed to the verify_calibration node's log (docker logs moveit_pro_<instance>-runtime-1 2>&1 | grep -A 7 'Verify Calibration:'), not to this Objective's log. Works on mock too: mock starts at config/initial_positions.yaml, so the errors there are that pose's radians converted to ticks.

Action.message: Checking calibration. Hold every joint at URDF zero (mid-travel; gripper NEAR-CLOSED) before reading the result below.
